BMS Building Materials Suisse ist ein Grosshändler für Baumaterial im Rohbau und Innenausbau. Zu unserer Unternehmensgruppe gehören die namhaften Spezialisten Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton und RegusciReco . Unsere erfahrenen Fachleute beraten, unterstützen und inspirieren mit grossem Engagement Kunden aus der Bauwirtschaft sowie Privatkunden an rund 110 Standorten in der ganzen Schweiz. Nahe am Baualltag sind wir der lokale und verlässliche Partner für jedes Bauprojekt. Schnell, einfach und kompetent.
Deine Leidenschaft für den Rohbau trifft auf Führungskompetenz?
Dann bist du bei uns richtig!
Wir suchen per 1. Oktober 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung eine*n motivierte*n und erfahrene*n Teamleiter*in für unseren Baubedarf - Shop in Grenchen .
Bei uns dreht sich alles um hochwertige Materialien, starke Partnerschaften und exzellenten Service. Wenn du nicht nur ein Händchen für Rohbauprodukte, sondern auch für Teamführung hast und die tägliche Herausforderung in einem dynamischen Umfeld liebst, dann freuen wir uns auf dich!

Verantwortung über die Lagerbewirtschaftung und Lagerbestände

BMS Building Materials Suisse è un grossista di materiali da costruzione per la costruzione di conchiglie e la costruzione di interni. Il nostro gruppo di aziende comprende i rinomati specialisti Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton e RegusciReco. I nostri esperti consigliano, supportano e ispirano i clienti del settore edile e i clienti privati in circa 110 sedi in tutta la Svizzera. Vicino alla costruzione quotidiana, siamo il partner locale e affidabile per ogni progetto di costruzione. Veloce, facile e competente.
La vostra passione per la costruzione delle conchiglie incontra la competenza di leadership?
Allora hai ragione con noi!
Siamo alla ricerca di un team leader motivato ed esperto per le nostre esigenze di costruzione - negozio a Grenchen dal 1 ottobre 2026 o per accordo.
Siamo tutti su materiali di alta qualità, partnership forti e servizio eccellente. Se non hai solo un aggancio per i prodotti per la costruzione di conchiglie, ma anche per la leadership del team e per amare la sfida quotidiana in un ambiente dinamico, allora ti aspettiamo!
Consigli tecnici e di vendita ai clienti
leadership professionale e organizzativa di un team di 2 e responsabilità per il loro sviluppo
Co-responsabilità per il Handwerkerzentrum e il suo sviluppo aziendale
Co-responsabilità degli obiettivi di vendita e di margine del luogo
Responsabilità per la gestione delle scorte
Attuazione di varie misure di promozione delle vendite, promozioni e promozioni
Preparazione e post-elaborazione di offerte, raccolta, consegna e reso note
Gestione e controllo delle note di consegna
Persona di contatto diretta per i nostri clienti pick-up
Se il tuo cuore batte più velocemente nell'area di attività sopra descritta e hai le seguenti esperienze e competenze, sei il nostro candidato desiderato:
Grande passione per le vendite e la consulenza
Formazione professionale completa, esperienza nel settore dell'edilizia
Conoscenza approfondita dell'ingegneria strutturale
Prima esperienza di leadership in una posizione paragonabile
Rete idealmente esistente nella regione
Alta motivazione e guidare per spostare il business in avanti
Metodi di lavoro autonomi e strutturati
Gomma affidabile
Buona conoscenza del tedesco nelle parole e nella scrittura
un lavoro impegnativo, versatile e interessante in un buon ambiente di lavoro in cui la cooperazione attiva e il lavoro autonomo sono sottolineati
La formazione intensiva è un programma, per cui i nostri nuovi colleghi possono beneficiare della formazione di prodotto e di sistema all'interno dell'azienda
Sostenere i nostri dipendenti nel loro sviluppo professionale e personale
Nessun turno e uso del fine settimana
Quota salariale base lorda x 13 plus
Informazioni sulla posizione clicca qui
5 settimane di vacanza (6 settimane da 50 anni) e shopping fino a max. 10 giorni, benefici aggiuntivi come un fondo pensione indipendente eccellentemente finanziato e sconti sulla nostra gamma completa di prodotti e benefici premium esterni
Attendiamo con ansia i vostri documenti applicativi completi in forma elettronica.

BMS Building Materials Suisse is a wholesaler of building materials for shell construction and interior construction. Our group of companies includes the renowned specialists Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton and RegusciReco. Our experienced experts advise, support and inspire customers from the construction industry as well as private customers at around 110 locations throughout Switzerland. Close to everyday construction, we are the local and reliable partner for every construction project. Quick, easy and competent.
Your passion for shell construction meets leadership competence?
Then you are right with us!
We are looking for a motivated and experienced team leader for our construction needs - shop in Grenchen as of 1 October 2026 or by agreement.
We are all about high-quality materials, strong partnerships and excellent service. If you not only have a knack for shell construction products, but also for team leadership and love the daily challenge in a dynamic environment, then we look forward to you!
Technical and sales advice to customers
Professional and organizational leadership of a team of 2 as well as responsibility for their development
Co-responsibility for the Handwerkerzentrum and its business development
Co-responsibility of the sales and margin targets of the location
Responsibility for stock management and stockpiles
Implementation of various sales promotion measures, promotions and promotions
Preparation and post-processing of offers, collection, delivery and returns notes
Entry and exit handling and control of delivery notes
Direct contact person for our pick-up customers
If your heart beats faster in the task area described above and you have the following experiences and competencies, you are our desired candidate:
Great passion for sales and consulting
Completed vocational training, experience in the construction industry beneficial
In-depth knowledge in structural engineering
First leadership experience in a comparable position
Ideally existing network in the region
High motivation and drive to move the business forward
Self-employed and structured working methods
Reliable gum
Good knowledge of German in words and writing
a challenging, versatile and interesting job in a good working environment in which active cooperation and self-employment are emphasised
Intensive training is a program, whereby our new colleagues can benefit from product and system training within the company
Support our employees in their professional and personal development
No shift and weekend use
Basic wage gross x 13 plus variable wage share
Location information click here
5 weeks holiday (6 weeks from 50 years of age) and holiday shopping up to max. 10 days, additional benefits such as an excellently financed independent pension fund and discounts on our complete product range as well as external premium benefits
We look forward to your complete application documents in electronic form.
Want to know more about us? Now visit our career page at jobs.bmsuisse.ch.
We are happy to answer your questions at jobs@bmsuisse.ch.
Janti Hirtl – recruiter German-speaking Switzerland

Notre groupe d'entreprises comprend les spécialistes renommés Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton et RegusciReco. Nos experts expérimentés conseillent, soutiennent et inspirent les clients de l'industrie de la construction ainsi que les clients privés dans environ 110 endroits en Suisse. Proche de la construction quotidienne, nous sommes le partenaire local et fiable pour chaque projet de construction. Rapide, facile et compétent.
Votre passion pour la construction de coquillages répond aux compétences de leadership ?
Alors tu as raison avec nous !
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un chef d'équipe motivé et expérimenté pour nos besoins de construction - magasin à Grenchen à partir du 1er octobre 2026 ou par accord.
Nous parlons de matériaux de haute qualité, de partenariats solides et d'un excellent service. Si vous avez non seulement un knack pour les produits de construction en coque, mais aussi pour le leadership d'équipe et aimez le défi quotidien dans un environnement dynamique, alors nous nous réjouissons de vous!

Personne de contact directe pour nos clients

Grande passion pour les ventes et le conseil
Formation professionnelle terminée, expérience dans le secteur de la construction bénéfique
Connaissance approfondie en ingénierie structurelle
Première expérience de leadership dans un poste comparable
Idéalement, le réseau existant dans la région
Motivation élevée et volonté de faire avancer l'entreprise

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione

BMS Building Materials Switzerland è un grossista di materiali da costruzione per lavori strutturali e di finitura. Del nostro gruppo aziendale fanno parte i rinomati specialisti Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton e RegusciReco. I nostri specialisti esperti consigliano, supportano e ispirano con grande impegno clienti del settore edile e clienti privati ​​in 110 sedi in tutta la Svizzera. Vicini alla vita quotidiana dell'edilizia, siamo il partner locale e affidabile per ogni progetto di costruzione. Veloce, semplice e competente.

Vuoi occupare una posizione strategica, diversificata e di grande impatto al centro dello sviluppo dell'offerta prodotti? Ti piace anticipare le tendenze del mercato, costruire assortimenti efficaci e lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di vendita, marketing, acquisti e fornitori? Allora questa opportunità potrebbe essere perfetta per te. Stiamo reclutando il nostro futuro collaboratore per il team Bulle as

Missioni

- Sei responsabile della gestione dei prodotti per le categorie di design parquet, vinile, laminato, porte e legno per esterni
- Sviluppi ed evolvi un assortimento innovativo, coerente, competitivo e redditizio
- Analizzi le tendenze del mercato, l'ambiente competitivo e le aspettative dei clienti al fine di identificare nuove opportunità di sviluppo
- Definisci e implementi strategie di prodotto, assortimento e marketing
- Lavori a stretto contatto con i team Acquisti, Vendite, Marketing e con i fornitori
- Supporti attivamente i team di vendita durante il lancio di prodotti, la formazione e i progetti dei clienti
- Sviluppi e mantieni forti rapporti con i fornitori, negoziando le condizioni commerciali
- Gestisci il ciclo di vita dei prodotti, dalla loro introduzione alla loro evoluzione
- Partecipi alla definizione delle strategie di prezzo e al posizionamento delle gamme
- Conduci la formazione sul prodotto e fai presentazioni a contatti interni ed esterni
- Viaggi regolarmente in tutta la Svizzera per stare vicino ai clienti, ai partner, alle sedi e al mercato
- Garantisci un monitoraggio attivo delle innovazioni, dei materiali, delle tendenze del design e degli sviluppi sostenibili nel settore

Profilo ricercato

- Possiedi una formazione CFC o tecnico commerciale, idealmente integrata da una formazione continua nella gestione del prodotto, nel marketing, nelle vendite o nella gestione aziendale
- Hai diversi anni di esperienza nella gestione dei prodotti, nella gestione delle categorie o in una funzione simile
- Possiedi una solida conoscenza del settore in una o più delle seguenti aree: pavimentazioni, porte, interior design, prodotti da giardino/outdoor
- Sei fortemente orientato ai risultati e sai come identificare il potenziale di mercato e le esigenze dei clienti
- Ti distingui per la tua personalità imprenditoriale, innovativa e visionaria
- Dimostri iniziativa, struttura e una forte capacità di portare a compimento le tue idee
- Ti senti a tuo agio nelle trattative e sai come convincere i tuoi interlocutori
- Apprezzi la collaborazione interfunzionale e comunichi facilmente con profili diversi
- Combini mente analitica, pragmatismo e approccio sul campo
- Sei disposto a viaggiare frequentemente a livello nazionale
- Parli fluentemente il francese e il tedesco, sia parlati che scritti; qualsiasi altra lingua, in particolare l'inglese, è una risorsa

Cosa offriamo

- Un'attività stimolante, versatile e interessante in un buon ambiente lavorativo, dove è valorizzata la collaborazione attiva incoraggiando l'autonomia.
- È previsto un intenso programma di integrazione che consentirà ai nostri nuovi colleghi di beneficiare della formazione sui prodotti e sui sistemi all'interno dell'azienda.
- Sostegno allo sviluppo professionale e personale dei nostri dipendenti.
- Una rete ben strutturata di centri artigiani oltre ad una stretta collaborazione con la direzione commerciale.
- 5 settimane di ferie (6 settimane a partire dai 50 anni) con possibilità di acquistare ferie aggiuntive fino a 10 giorni, vantaggi aggiuntivi come un fondo pensione indipendente e ben finanziato, nonché sconti sull'intera gamma di prodotti e ulteriori vantaggi esterni.

Contatto

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere i documenti della tua candidatura (lettera di presentazione, CV, file completo) facendo clic sul collegamento della domanda di seguito.
Vuoi saperne di più su di noi? Visita ora la nostra pagina dedicata alle carriere su https://jobs.bmsuisse.ch/
Getaz-Miauton SA
Caroline Göhring - Responsabile del reclutamento Svizzera romanda
Risponderemo volentieri alle vostre domande sulla posizione all'indirizzo jobs@bmsuisse.ch.
Per motivi di protezione dei dati non verranno prese in considerazione le candidature spontanee, nonché le candidature elettroniche tramite e-mail e/o posta ordinaria.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

BMS Building Materials Switzerland is a wholesaler of construction materials for the large and second work. Our group of companies includes the renowned specialists of Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton and RegusciReco. Our experienced specialists advise, support and inspire with great commitment the customers of the construction sector and private customers on 110 sites throughout Switzerland. Close to the daily construction, we are the local and reliable partner for every construction project. Fast, simple and competent.

You want to be a strategic, varied and highly impactful position at the product development department? You like to anticipate market trends, build high-performance sets and work closely with sales, marketing, purchasing and supplier teams? Then this opportunity could perfectly match you. We are recruiting our future collaborator for the Bulle team as our

Mission

- You are responsible for product management for parquet, vinyl, laminate, doors and exterior wood - You develop and develop an innovative, consistent, competitive and cost-effective assortment - You analyze market trends, the competitive environment and customer expectations in order to identify new development opportunities - You define and implement product, assortment and marketing strategies - You work closely with the Purchasing, Sales, Marketing and, with suppliers - You

Actively accompany the business teams during product launches, training and customer projects - You develop and maintain strong relationships with suppliers, while negotiating the commercial conditions - You guide the product life cycle from introduction to evolution - You participate in the definition of pricing strategies and the positioning of the ranges - You lead product training and make presentations to internal and external contacts - You make regular trips throughout Switzerland to ensure that the product is not lost or lost.

Stay close to customers, partners, sites and the market - You are actively monitoring innovations, materials, design trends and sustainable developments in the sector

Profile sought

- You have a CFC or technical business training, ideally supplemented by continuous training in product management, marketing, sales or management of, business - You justify several years of experience in product management, category management or similar function - You have strong industry knowledge in one or more of the following areas: floor coverings, doors, interior design, garden products / outdoor - You are strongly oriented and know how to identify market potentials and customer needs - You

You are able to make a difference in your entrepreneurial, innovative and visionary personality - You have a strong initiative, structure and ability to make your ideas concrete - You are comfortable in negotiating and know how to convince your interlocutors - You appreciate the cross-sectional collaboration and communicate with various profiles - You combine analytic, pragmatistic and field approach - You are willing to make frequent trips at the national level - You master French and German, both oral and written; any other language,

English is an asset

What we offer

- A stimulating, versatile and interesting activity in a good working environment, where active collaboration is valued while encouraging autonomy. - An intensive integration programme is planned, allowing our new colleagues to benefit from product and system training within the company. - Support for the professional and personal development of our employees. - A well-structured network of centres of artisans, as well as close collaboration with the commercial management.

- 5 weeks of holidays (6 weeks from 50 years) with the possibility of additional vacations up to 10 days, additional benefits such as a self-employed and well-funded pension fund, as well as reductions on our entire product range and additional external benefits.

Contact

We look forward to receiving your application documents (motivation letter, CV, complete file) by clicking on the application link below. Would you like to know more about us? Visit our career page on https://jobs.bmsuisse.ch/Gétaz-Miauton SA Caroline Göhring - Head of Recruitment Switzerland from the French-speaking part of France We will gladly answer your questions about the job at jobs@bmsuisse.ch.

For data protection reasons, unsolicited applications and electronic applications by e-mail and/or mail will not be taken into account.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung

BMS Baustoffe Schweiz ist ein Grosshändler für Baumaterialien für Rohbau und Ausbau. Zu unserer Unternehmensgruppe gehören die renommierten Spezialisten Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton und RegusciReco. Unsere erfahrenen Spezialisten beraten, unterstützen und begeistern Kunden aus der Baubranche und Privatkunden mit viel Engagement an 110 Standorten in der ganzen Schweiz. Nah am Baualltag sind wir der ortsansässige und zuverlässige Partner für jedes Bauvorhaben. Schnell, einfach und kompetent.

Möchten Sie eine strategische, abwechslungsreiche und wirkungsvolle Position im Zentrum der Entwicklung des Produktangebots einnehmen? Sie antizipieren gerne Markttrends, bauen effektive Sortimente auf und arbeiten eng mit den Vertriebs-, Marketing-, Einkaufs- und Lieferantenteams zusammen? Dann könnte diese Gelegenheit genau das Richtige für Sie sein. Wir rekrutieren unseren zukünftigen Mitarbeiter für das Bulle-Team als

Missionen

- Du verantwortest das Produktmanagement für die Kategorien Parkett, Vinyl, Laminat, Türen und Holzdesign im Außenbereich
- Sie entwickeln und entwickeln ein innovatives, kohärentes, wettbewerbsfähiges und profitables Sortiment
- Du analysierst Markttrends, das Wettbewerbsumfeld und Kundenerwartungen, um neue Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren
- Du definierst Produkt-, Sortiments- und Marketingstrategien und setzt diese um
- Sie arbeiten eng mit den Einkaufs-, Vertriebs- und Marketingteams sowie mit Lieferanten zusammen
- Du unterstützt die Vertriebsteams aktiv bei Produkteinführungen, Schulungen und Kundenprojekten
- Sie entwickeln und pflegen starke Beziehungen zu Lieferanten und verhandeln gleichzeitig kommerzielle Konditionen
- Sie verwalten den Lebenszyklus von Produkten, von der Einführung bis zur Weiterentwicklung
- Du beteiligst dich an der Definition von Preisstrategien und der Positionierung von Sortimenten
- Sie leiten Produktschulungen und halten Präsentationen vor internen und externen Ansprechpartnern
- Sie unternehmen regelmässige Reisen durch die ganze Schweiz, um nah an Kunden, Partnern, Standorten und dem Markt zu bleiben
- Sie sorgen für eine aktive Beobachtung von Innovationen, Materialien, Designtrends und nachhaltigen Entwicklungen in der Branche

Profil gesucht

- Sie verfügen über eine CFC- oder technisch-kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise ergänzt durch eine Weiterbildung im Produktmanagement, Marketing, Vertrieb oder Betriebswirtschaftslehre
- Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, Category Management oder einer ähnlichen Funktion
- Sie verfügen über fundierte Branchenkenntnisse in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche: Bodenbeläge, Türen, Innenarchitektur, Garten-/Outdoor-Produkte
- Sie sind stark ergebnisorientiert und verstehen es, Marktpotenziale sowie Kundenbedürfnisse zu erkennen
- Sie zeichnen sich durch Ihre unternehmerische, innovative und visionäre Persönlichkeit aus
- Sie zeigen Initiative, Struktur und die Fähigkeit, Ihre Ideen in die Tat umzusetzen
- Sie sind verhandlungssicher und wissen Ihre Gesprächspartner zu überzeugen
- Sie schätzen die funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit und kommunizieren problemlos mit unterschiedlichen Profilen
- Sie vereinen analytisches Denken, Pragmatismus und Feldansatz
- Sie sind bereit, häufig im Inland zu reisen
- Sie sprechen fließend Französisch und Deutsch in Wort und Schrift; Jede andere Sprache, insbesondere Englisch, ist von Vorteil

Was wir bieten

- Eine anregende, vielseitige und interessante Tätigkeit in einem guten Arbeitsumfeld, in dem aktive Zusammenarbeit geschätzt und gleichzeitig die Autonomie gefördert wird.
- Ein intensives Integrationsprogramm ist geplant, damit unsere neuen Kollegen von Produkt- und Systemschulungen im Unternehmen profitieren können.
- Unterstützung der beruflichen und persönlichen Entwicklung unserer Mitarbeiter.
- Ein gut strukturiertes Netzwerk von Handwerkszentren sowie eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Vertriebsleitung.
- 5 Wochen Urlaub (6 Wochen ab 50. Lebensjahr) mit der Möglichkeit zum Kauf von Zusatzurlaub von bis zu 10 Tagen, Zusatzleistungen wie einer unabhängigen und gut ausgestatteten Pensionskasse, sowie Vergünstigungen auf unser gesamtes Produktsortiment und zusätzliche externe Leistungen.

Kontakt

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, vollständige Unterlagen) über den unten stehenden Bewerbungslink.
Möchten Sie mehr über uns erfahren? Besuchen Sie jetzt unsere Karriereseite auf https://jobs.bmsuisse.ch/
Gétaz-Miauton SA
Caroline Göhring – Recruiting Manager Westschweiz
Gerne beantworten wir Ihre Fragen zur Stelle unter jobs@bmsuisse.ch.
Aus datenschutzrechtlichen Gründen werden Initiativbewerbungen sowie elektronische Bewerbungen per E-Mail und/oder Post nicht berücksichtigt.

BMS Building Materials Suisse ist ein Grosshändler für Baumaterial im Rohbau und Innenausbau. Zu unserer Unternehmensgruppe gehören die namhaften Spezialisten Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton und RegusciReco . Unsere erfahrenen Fachleute beraten, unterstützen und inspirieren mit grossem Engagement Kunden aus der Bauwirtschaft sowie Privatkunden an 110 Standorten in der ganzen Schweiz. Nahe am Baualltag sind wir der lokale und verlässliche Partner für jedes Bauprojekt. Schnell, einfach und kompetent.

Für unsere Fuhrparkabteilung (ca. 950 Einheiten, PKW, LKW, LNFZ, Stapler) mit Arbeitsort in Bern suchen wir per 1. Januar 2027 eine dienstleistungsorientierte Persönlichkeit als
Als Fleet Management Specialist bist Du zu allen Themen rund um unsere LKW, Fahrzeug- und Staplerflotte die zentrale Ansprechperson:
Selbstständige Sicherstellung des operativen Tagesgeschäfts für den Schweizer Fuhrpark mit rund 950 Einheiten (LKW, Anhänger, PKW, LNFZ, Gabelstapler etc.) sowie Koordination und Priorisierung aller laufenden Aufgaben unter Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorgaben und interner Richtlinien.
Abwicklung des gesamten Fahrzeuglebenszyklus von der Bestellung über Zulassung, Übernahme, Übergabe und Nutzerwechsel bis zur Rückgabe in Zusammenarbeit mit Importeuren, Leasinggesellschaften und internen Stellen.
Überwachung von Leasingverträgen, Laufzeiten, Kilometerständen, Budgets und laufenden Kosten, sowie Bearbeitung von Vertragsanpassungen, Mehr- und Minderkilometern und vorzeitigen Rückgaben.
Prüfung, Kontrolle und Verarbeitung der fleetbezogener Rechnungen.
Koordination von Wartungen, Reparaturen, Reifenwechseln, Pannen und Fahrzeugschäden sowie Abwicklung und Nachverfolgung von Schaden- und Versicherungsfällen in Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Stakeholdern.
Zentrale Ansprechperson für Fahrzeugnutzer, sowie interne Fachstellen wie Finance, Controlling, HR und Payroll und operative Schnittstelle zu Leasinggesellschaften, Garagen, Versicherungen, Reifenpartnern, Tankkartenanbietern und weiteren Dienstleistern.
Analyse, Standardisierung und Digitalisierung der Fuhrparkprozesse, sowie Sicherstellung einer aktuellen und verlässlichen Datenbasis. Entwicklung automatisierter Workflows, Kennzahlen und Reports zur Reduktion von Kosten, Fehlerquoten, Durchlaufzeiten und administrativem Aufwand.
Umsetzung der schrittweisen Elektrifizierung des Fuhrparks sowie Koordination und Nachverfolgung von Fahrzeugumstellungen, Ladeinfrastruktur, Standortanforderungen, Dienstleistern, internen Fachstellen, Terminen, Kosten und Projektfortschritt.
Unterstützung bei Tarifverhandlungen mit Servicepartnern, selbständige Durchführung von kleineren Vertragsverhandlungen.
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Fleet Manager bei Optimierungsmassnahmen und Projekten, sowie bereichsübergreifenden Themen.
Um diese vielseitigen Herausforderungen erfolgreich meistern zu können, bringst Du folgende Kompetenzen mit:
Fundierte Erfahrung im Flottenmanagement, im Automotive-Bereich oder in administrativen Funktionen mit hoher Koordinationsdichte.
Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Automobilbranche.
Gute bis sehr gute Deutsch-, Französisch- und Englisch Kenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
Erfahrung im Leasing- und Schadenmanagement ist von Vorteil.
Technische Affinität sowie analytische Fähigkeiten.
Digitale Affinität und sicherer Umgang mit MS Office sowie IT-/ERP-Tools.
Ausgeprägte organisatorische Fähigkeiten sowie Freude im Umgang mit Menschen.
Kommunikationsstärke, Dienstleistungsorientierung, Projektmanagementerfahrung und Verhandlungsgeschick.
Exakte, gewissenhafte, selbstständige, strukturierte und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise.
Flexibilität, Belastbarkeit und Teamfähigkeit.
Eine herausfordernde, vielseitige und interessante Tätigkeit in einem guten Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Wert auf aktive Zusammenarbeit und gleichzeitig Selbständigkeit gelegt wird.
Ein umfassendes Einarbeitungsprogramm; unsere neuen Kolleginnen und Kollegen profitieren zudem von internen Schulungen zu Produkten und Systemen
Unterstützung bei der beruflichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung unserer Mitarbeitenden
Ein gut etabliertes Netzwerk von Handwerkerzentren sowie eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Verkaufsleitung
Mitarbeitendenrabatte, verschiedene Vergünstigungen wie Flottenrabatte, Ermässigungen in ausgewählten Fitnesszentren sowie zahlreiche Angebote zur Förderung der mentalen und körperlichen Gesundheit
Ein attraktives Vergütungspaket kombiniert mit einer soliden Pensionskasse, mit flexiblen Sparbeiträgen und einem überdurchschnittlichen Arbeitgeberanteil
5 Wochen Ferien (6 Wochen ab 50 Jahren) sowie die Möglichkeit, bis zu 10 zusätzliche Ferientage zu kaufen, dazu ergänzende Leistungen wie eine eigenständige, sehr vorteilhaft finanzierte Pensionskasse, Rabatte auf unser gesamtes Produktsortiment sowie externe Prämienvorteile
Wir freuen uns auf Deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen in elektronischer Form.
Willst Du mehr über uns erfahren? Besuche jetzt unsere Karriere-Seite unter jobs.bmsuisse.ch .
Baubedarf-Richner-Miauton

Caroline Göhring – Rekruterin Westschweiz

BMS Building Materials Suisse è un grossista di materiali da costruzione per la costruzione di conchiglie e la costruzione di interni. Il nostro gruppo di aziende comprende i rinomati specialisti Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton e RegusciReco. I nostri esperti consigliano, sostengono e ispirano i clienti del settore edile e i clienti privati in 110 sedi in tutta la Svizzera. Vicino alla costruzione quotidiana, siamo il partner locale e affidabile per ogni progetto di costruzione. Veloce, facile e competente.

Per il nostro dipartimento di flotta (circa 950 unità, auto, camion, LNFZ, camion) con posto di lavoro a Berna stiamo cercando 1. Gennaio 2027 una personalità orientata al servizio
In qualità di specialista di gestione delle flotte, siete la persona di contatto centrale per tutti gli argomenti relativi ai nostri camion, veicoli e camion flotta:
Assicurando in modo indipendente le operazioni giornaliere per la flotta svizzera di circa 950 unità (truck, rimorchi, auto, LNFZ, carrelli elevatori, ecc.) nonché coordinando e privilegiando tutte le attività in corso nel rispetto dei requisiti legali e delle linee guida interne.
Completamento dell'intero ciclo di vita del veicolo da ordinazione a registrazione, acquisizione, trasferimento e cambio utente per tornare in collaborazione con importatori, società di leasing e organismi interni.
Monitoraggio dei contratti di locazione, dei termini, dei fuorvi, dei bilanci e dei costi in corso, nonché del trattamento degli adeguamenti contrattuali, dei chilometri più e più brevi e dei rendimenti anticipati.
verifica, controllo e elaborazione delle fatture relative alla flotta.
Coordinamento della manutenzione, delle riparazioni, dei cambi dei pneumatici, dei guasti e dei danni dei veicoli, nonché della gestione e del monitoraggio dei reclami e dei casi di assicurazione in collaborazione con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni.
Contatto centrale per gli utenti del veicolo, così come gli uffici specializzati interni come finanza, controllo, HR e Payroll e l'interfaccia operativa per leasing aziende, garage, assicurazioni, partner pneumatici, fornitori di carte a combustibile e altri fornitori di servizi.
Analisi, standardizzazione e digitalizzazione dei processi della flotta, oltre a garantire un database attuale e affidabile. Sviluppo di flussi di lavoro automatizzati, cifre chiave e report per ridurre i costi, i tassi di errore, i tempi di piombo e gli sforzi amministrativi.
Attuazione dell'elettrificazione passo-passo della flotta del veicolo, nonché coordinamento e monitoraggio delle conversioni dei veicoli, infrastrutture di ricarica, requisiti di localizzazione, fornitori di servizi, dipartimenti specializzati interni, scadenze, costi e progresso del progetto.
Sostegno alla contrattazione collettiva con i partner di servizio, implementazione indipendente dei negoziati contrattuali più piccoli.
Una stretta collaborazione con il Fleet Manager sulle misure di ottimizzazione e i progetti, nonché su argomenti cross-divisionali.
Al fine di padroneggiare con successo queste sfide versatili, si mettono le seguenti competenze:
Esperienza approfondita nella gestione della flotta, nel settore automobilistico o nelle funzioni amministrative con un elevato grado di coordinamento.
Conoscenza approfondita nell'industria automobilistica.
Buono a molto buona conoscenza di tedesco, francese e inglese in parola e scrittura.
L'esperienza nel leasing e la gestione dei crediti è un vantaggio.
affinità tecnica e competenze analitiche.
Affinità digitale e gestione sicura degli strumenti MS Office e IT/ERP.
Forte capacità organizzative e piacere nel trattare con le persone.
Resistenza alla comunicazione, orientamento al servizio, esperienza di gestione del progetto e competenze di negoziazione.
Metodi di lavoro precisi, coscienziosi, indipendenti, strutturati e responsabili.
Flessibilità, resistenza e lavoro di squadra.
Un lavoro impegnativo, versatile e interessante in un buon ambiente di lavoro, dove l'accento è sulla cooperazione attiva e allo stesso tempo l'autooccupazione.
L'induzione intensiva è un programma, dove i nostri nuovi colleghi possono beneficiare della formazione di prodotto e di sistema all'interno dell'azienda.
Sostenere i nostri dipendenti nel loro sviluppo professionale e personale
Scommessa di base lorda x 13 più quota salariale variabile.
5 settimane di vacanza (6 settimane da 50 anni) e shopping fino a max. 10 giorni, benefici aggiuntivi come un fondo pensione indipendente eccellentemente finanziato e sconti sulla nostra gamma completa di prodotti e benefici premium esterni.
Attendiamo con ansia i vostri documenti applicativi completi in forma elettronica.
Vuoi saperne di più su di noi? Ora visita la nostra pagina di carriera a job.bmsuisse.ch.

BMS Building Materials Suisse is a wholesaler of building materials for shell construction and interior construction. Our group of companies includes the renowned specialists Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton and RegusciReco. Our experienced experts advise, support and inspire customers from the construction industry as well as private customers at 110 locations throughout Switzerland. Close to everyday construction, we are the local and reliable partner for every construction project. Quick, easy and competent.

For our fleet department (about 950 units, cars, trucks, LNFZ, trucks) with place of work in Bern we are looking for 1. January 2027 a service-oriented personality as
As a Fleet Management Specialist, you are the central contact person for all topics relating to our trucks, vehicle and truck fleet:
Independently ensuring day-to-day operations for the Swiss fleet of around 950 units (trucks, trailers, cars, LNFZ, forklifts, etc.) as well as coordinating and prioritizing all ongoing tasks in compliance with legal requirements and internal guidelines.
Completion of the entire vehicle life cycle from ordering to registration, takeover, transfer and user change to return in cooperation with importers, leasing companies and internal bodies.
Monitoring lease contracts, terms, mileages, budgets and ongoing costs, as well as processing of contract adjustments, multi- and shorter kilometres and early returns.
audit, control and processing of fleet-related invoices.
Coordination of maintenance, repairs, tyre changes, breakdowns and vehicle damage as well as handling and tracking of claims and insurance cases in cooperation with internal and external stakeholders.
Central contact for vehicle users, as well as internal specialist offices such as Finance, Controlling, HR and Payroll and operational interface to leasing companies, garages, insurance companies, tire partners, fuel card providers and other service providers.
Analysis, standardization and digitalization of fleet processes, as well as ensuring a current and reliable database. Development of automated workflows, key figures and reports to reduce costs, error rates, lead times and administrative effort.
Implementation of the step-by-step electrification of the vehicle fleet as well as coordination and tracking of vehicle conversions, charging infrastructure, location requirements, service providers, internal specialist departments, deadlines, costs and project progress.
Support in collective bargaining with service partners, independent implementation of smaller contract negotiations.
Close cooperation with the Fleet Manager on optimization measures and projects, as well as cross-divisional topics.
In order to successfully master these versatile challenges, you bring the following competencies:
In-depth experience in fleet management, in the automotive sector or in administrative functions with a high degree of coordination.
In-depth knowledge in the automotive industry.
Good to very good knowledge of German, French and English in word and writing.
Experience in leasing and claims management is an advantage.
Technical affinity and analytical skills.
Digital affinity and secure handling of MS Office and IT/ERP tools.
Strong organizational skills as well as pleasure in dealing with people.
Communication strength, service orientation, project management experience and negotiation skills.
Precise, conscientious, independent, structured and responsible working methods.
Flexibility, resilience and teamwork.
A challenging, versatile and interesting job in a good working environment, where the emphasis is on active cooperation and at the same time self-employment.
Intensive induction is a program, where our new colleagues can benefit from product and system training within the company.
Support our employees in their professional and personal development
Basic wage gross x 13 plus variable wage share.
5 weeks holiday (6 weeks from 50 years of age) and holiday shopping up to max. 10 days, additional benefits such as an excellently financed independent pension fund and discounts on our complete product range as well as external premium benefits.
We look forward to your complete application documents in electronic form.
Want to know more about us? Now visit our career page at jobs.bmsuisse.ch.
Building supplies-Richner-Miauton
We are happy to answer your questions at jobs@bmsuisse.ch.
Caroline Göhring – recruiter in Western Switzerland
You can become an employee anywhere. We are looking for influencers.

Proche de la construction quotidienne, nous sommes le partenaire local et fiable pour chaque projet de construction. Rapide, facile et compétent.

Pour notre département de la flotte (environ 950 unités, voitures, camions, LNFZ, camions) avec lieu de travail à Berne nous cherchons 1. Janvier 2027 une personnalité orientée vers le service comme
En tant que spécialiste de la gestion du parc automobile, vous êtes la personne-ressource centrale pour tous les sujets liés à nos camions, véhicules et camions :
Assurer les opérations quotidiennes de la flotte suisse d'environ 950 unités (camions, remorques, voitures, LNFZ, chariots élévateurs, etc.) ainsi que coordonner et hiérarchiser toutes les tâches en cours conformément aux exigences légales et aux directives internes.
Achèvement de l'ensemble du cycle de vie du véhicule, de la commande à l'immatriculation, à la prise en charge, au transfert et au changement d'utilisateur, en coopération avec les importateurs, les sociétés de location et les organismes internes.
Surveiller les contrats de location, les modalités, les kilométrages, les budgets et les coûts permanents, ainsi que le traitement des ajustements contractuels, les kilomètres multiples et courts et les retours anticipés.
vérification, contrôle et traitement des factures relatives à la flotte.
Coordination de l'entretien, des réparations, des changements de pneus, des pannes et des dommages causés aux véhicules ainsi que du traitement et du suivi des réclamations et des dossiers d'assurance, en coopération avec les parties prenantes internes et externes.
Contact central pour les utilisateurs de véhicules, ainsi que des bureaux spécialisés internes tels que Finance, Contrôle, RH et Payroll et interface opérationnelle pour les sociétés de location, garages, compagnies d'assurance, partenaires de pneus, fournisseurs de cartes de carburant et autres fournisseurs de services.
Analyse, normalisation et numérisation des processus de flotte, ainsi qu'une base de données à jour et fiable. Élaboration de flux de travail automatisés, de chiffres clés et de rapports afin de réduire les coûts, les taux d'erreurs, les délais d'exécution et les efforts administratifs.
Mise en oeuvre de l'électrification progressive du parc de véhicules ainsi que de la coordination et du suivi des conversions de véhicules, de l'infrastructure de tarification, des exigences en matière de localisation, des fournisseurs de services, des services internes spécialisés, des échéances, des coûts et de l'avancement des projets.
Soutien à la négociation collective avec les partenaires de services, mise en oeuvre indépendante de négociations contractuelles plus petites.
Coopération étroite avec le gestionnaire de la flotte sur les mesures d'optimisation et les projets, ainsi que sur les sujets interdivisionnels.

Expérience approfondie dans la gestion de la flotte, dans le secteur automobile ou dans les fonctions administratives avec un haut degré de coordination.
Connaissance approfondie de l'industrie automobile.
Bon à très bonne connaissance de l'allemand, du français et de l'anglais en paroles et en écriture.
L'expérience de la location et de la gestion des réclamations est un avantage.
affinité technique et compétences analytiques.
affinité numérique et manipulation sécurisée des outils MS Office et IT/ERP.
Des compétences organisationnelles solides ainsi que le plaisir de traiter avec les gens.
Capacité de communication, orientation des services, expérience en gestion de projet et compétences en négociation.
Méthodes de travail précises, consciencieuses, indépendantes, structurées et responsables.
Flexibilité, résilience et travail d'équipe.
Un travail stimulant, polyvalent et intéressant dans un bon environnement de travail, où l'accent est mis sur la coopération active et en même temps sur le travail indépendant.
L'induction intensive est un programme où nos nouveaux collègues peuvent bénéficier de la formation produit et système au sein de l'entreprise.
Soutenir nos employés dans leur développement professionnel et personnel
Salaire de base brut x 13 plus part variable du salaire.
5 semaines de vacances (6 semaines à partir de 50 ans) et des achats de vacances jusqu'à max. 10 jours, des prestations supplémentaires telles qu'un fonds de pension indépendant financé avec excellence et des rabais sur notre gamme complète de produits ainsi que des primes externes.

BMS Building Materials Suisse ist ein Grosshändler für Baumaterial im Rohbau und Innenausbau. Zu unserer Unternehmensgruppe gehören die namhaften Spezialisten Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton und RegusciReco . Unsere erfahrenen Fachleute beraten, unterstützen und inspirieren mit grossem Engagement Kunden aus der Bauwirtschaft sowie Privatkunden an rund 110 Standorten in der ganzen Schweiz. Nahe am Baualltag sind wir der lokale und verlässliche Partner für jedes Bauprojekt. Schnell, einfach und kompetent.
Offertenprofi gesucht!
Du jonglierst Anfragen mit Leichtigkeit, behaltest stets den Überblick und hast ein Gespür für erstklassigen Kundenservice? Dann bist du im Customer Care Team der Marke Richner genau richtig!

Klingt spannend? Dann werde Teil unseres dynamischen Teams und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Branche!
Jetzt bewerben und durchstarten!

Du bist verantwortlich für alle telefonischen Anliegen unserer Kundschaft (vornehmlich gewerbliche Kunden aus der Sanitär-Branche)

Du bringst eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Sanitär / Haustechnik / Innenausbau oder eine kaufmännische Ausbildung mit technischem Hintergrund resp. grosser Affinität Richtung Innenausbau

BMS Building Materials Suisse è un grossista di materiali da costruzione per la costruzione di conchiglie e la costruzione di interni. Il nostro gruppo di aziende comprende i rinomati specialisti Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton e RegusciReco. I nostri esperti consigliano, supportano e ispirano i clienti del settore edile e i clienti privati in circa 110 sedi in tutta la Svizzera. Vicino alla costruzione quotidiana, siamo il partner locale e affidabile per ogni progetto di costruzione. Veloce, facile e competente.
Alla ricerca di un'offerta professionale!
Si confrontano le richieste con facilità, sempre tenere traccia e avere un senso del servizio clienti di prima classe? Allora siete esattamente nel Customer Care Team del marchio Richner!
Per la nostra posizione a Buchs (AG), stiamo cercando una personalità impegnata per la Regione Centrale immediatamente o per accordo. Con la vostra competenza e il vostro talento organizzativo, assicuratevi che i nostri clienti nel settore sanitario siano ben consigliati e curati.
Sembra eccitante? Quindi diventare parte del nostro team dinamico e modellare il futuro del settore con noi!
Applicare ora e iniziare!
I vostri compiti principali includono la creazione e la lavorazione di offerte e presentazioni nella zona di ristrutturazione del bagno fino a sovrastrutture, ospedali e strutture alberghiere.
Sei responsabile di tutte le richieste telefoniche dei nostri clienti (principalmente clienti commerciali dal settore sanitario)
Da questo, fornire informazioni, fare chiarimenti e lavorare a stretto contatto con il servizio sul campo, account chiave, consulenti espositivi e l'elaborazione degli ordini.
Ulteriori compiti amministrativi come la ricezione delle richieste dei clienti, l'ottenimento di offerte e schizzi su misura da parte dei fornitori completano il campo di attività.
Se il tuo cuore batte più velocemente nell'area di attività sopra descritta e porti le seguenti competenze, sei il nostro candidato desiderato:
Si porta una formazione completa nel campo della tecnologia sanitaria / costruzione / interior design o una formazione commerciale con uno sfondo tecnico resp. Grande affinità verso l'interior design
Abbiamo bisogno di una buona conoscenza IT e una gestione esperta dei programmi comuni di MS-Office
Il pensiero in rete, l'orientamento del cliente e la consapevolezza di alta qualità migliorano il tuo profilo
I vostri vantaggi sono metodi di lavoro dettagliati e orientati al team
Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco in parola e la scrittura è richiesta
un lavoro impegnativo, versatile e interessante in un buon ambiente di lavoro in cui la cooperazione attiva e il lavoro autonomo sono sottolineati
La formazione intensiva è un programma, per cui i nostri nuovi colleghi possono beneficiare della formazione di prodotto e di sistema all'interno dell'azienda
Sostenere i nostri dipendenti nel loro sviluppo professionale e personale
Ufficio domestico possibile secondo regolamenti e accordo
5 settimane di vacanza (6 settimane da 50 anni) e shopping fino a max. 10 giorni, benefici aggiuntivi come un fondo pensione indipendente eccellentemente finanziato e sconti sulla nostra gamma completa di prodotti e benefici premium esterni
Attendiamo con ansia i vostri documenti applicativi completi in forma elettronica.
Vuoi saperne di più su di noi? Ora visita la nostra pagina di carriera a job.bmsuisse.ch.
Siamo lieti di rispondere alle vostre domande all'indirizzo job@bmsuisse.ch.
Per motivi di protezione dei dati, applicazioni di iniziativa e applicazioni via e-mail e/o posta non sono più considerati.
Puoi diventare un dipendente ovunque. Stiamo cercando degli influencer.

BMS Building Materials Suisse is a wholesaler of building materials for shell construction and interior construction. Our group of companies includes the renowned specialists Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton and RegusciReco. Our experienced experts advise, support and inspire customers from the construction industry as well as private customers at around 110 locations throughout Switzerland. Close to everyday construction, we are the local and reliable partner for every construction project. Quick, easy and competent.
Looking for an offer professional!
You juggle requests with ease, always keep track and have a sense of first-class customer service? Then you are exactly right in the Customer Care Team of the Richner brand!
For our location in Buchs (AG), we are looking for a committed personality for the Central Region immediately or by agreement. With your competence and your organizational talent, you ensure that our customers in the sanitary industry are well advised and looked after.
Sounds exciting? Then become part of our dynamic team and shape the future of the industry with us!
Apply now and get started!
Your main tasks include the creation and processing of offers and submissions in the area of bathroom renovation up to overbuildings, hospitals and hotel facilities.
You are responsible for all telephone requests of our customers (mainly commercial customers from the sanitary industry)
From this, you provide information, make clarifications and work closely with field service, key account, exhibition consultants and order processing.
Further administrative tasks such as receiving customer inquiries, obtaining offers and tailor-made sketches from suppliers round off the field of activity.
If your heart beats faster in the task area described above and you bring the following competencies, you are our desired candidate:
You bring a completed training in the field of sanitary / building technology / interior design or a commercial training with a technical background resp. Great affinity towards interior design
We require good IT knowledge and an experienced handling of the common MS-Office programs
Networked thinking, customer orientation and high quality awareness enhance your profile
Your advantages are detailed and team-oriented working methods
Very good knowledge of German in word and writing is required
a challenging, versatile and interesting job in a good working environment in which active cooperation and self-employment are emphasised
Intensive training is a program, whereby our new colleagues can benefit from product and system training within the company
Support our employees in their professional and personal development
Home office possible according to regulations and agreement
5 weeks holiday (6 weeks from 50 years of age) and holiday shopping up to max. 10 days, additional benefits such as an excellently financed independent pension fund and discounts on our complete product range as well as external premium benefits
We look forward to your complete application documents in electronic form.
Want to know more about us? Now visit our career page at jobs.bmsuisse.ch.
We are happy to answer your questions at jobs@bmsuisse.ch.
For data protection reasons, initiative applications and e-applications via email and/or postal mail are no longer considered.
You can become an employee anywhere. We are looking for influencers.

BMS Building Materials Suisse est un grossiste de matériaux de construction pour la construction en coque et la construction intérieure. Notre groupe d'entreprises comprend les spécialistes renommés Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton et RegusciReco. Nos experts expérimentés conseillent, soutiennent et inspirent les clients de l'industrie de la construction ainsi que les clients privés dans environ 110 endroits en Suisse. Proche de la construction quotidienne, nous sommes le partenaire local et fiable pour chaque projet de construction. Rapide, facile et compétent.
Vous cherchez une offre professionnelle!
Vous jonglez les demandes avec facilité, gardez toujours la trace et avez un sens du service à la clientèle de première classe? Alors vous êtes exactement dans l'équipe de service client de la marque Richner !
Pour notre emplacement à Buchs (AG), nous recherchons une personnalité engagée pour la Région Centrale immédiatement ou par accord. Avec votre compétence et votre talent organisationnel, vous veillez à ce que nos clients de l'industrie sanitaire soient bien conseillés et soignés.
Ça semble excitant ? Faites ensuite partie de notre équipe dynamique et façonnez l'avenir de l'industrie avec nous!
Appliquer maintenant et commencer!
Vos tâches principales comprennent la création et le traitement d'offres et de soumissions dans le domaine de la rénovation de salle de bains jusqu'à des constructions excessives, hôpitaux et installations hôtelières.
Vous êtes responsable de toutes les demandes téléphoniques de nos clients (principalement des clients commerciaux de l'industrie sanitaire)
De ce fait, vous fournissez des informations, apportez des éclaircissements et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec le service sur le terrain, le compte-clé, les consultants en exposition et le traitement des commandes.
D'autres tâches administratives telles que la réception des demandes de renseignements des clients, l'obtention d'offres et de croquis sur mesure auprès des fournisseurs complètent le champ d'activité.
Si votre cœur bat plus vite dans la zone de travail décrite ci-dessus et que vous apportez les compétences suivantes, vous êtes notre candidat désiré:
Vous apportez une formation complète dans le domaine de la technologie sanitaire / bâtiment / design d'intérieur ou une formation commerciale avec un fond technique resp. Grande affinité avec le design intérieur
Nous avons besoin de bonnes connaissances en TI et d'une gestion expérimentée des programmes communs MS-Office
La pensée en réseau, l'orientation client et la sensibilisation de haute qualité améliorent votre profil
Vos avantages sont des méthodes de travail détaillées et axées sur l'équipe
Une très bonne connaissance de l'allemand en paroles et en écriture est requise
un emploi stimulant, polyvalent et intéressant dans un bon environnement de travail où la coopération active et le travail indépendant sont soulignés
La formation intensive est un programme qui permet à nos nouveaux collègues de bénéficier de la formation produit et système au sein de l'entreprise.
Soutenir nos employés dans leur développement professionnel et personnel
Cabinet possible selon les règlements et l'accord
5 semaines de vacances (6 semaines à partir de 50 ans) et des achats de vacances jusqu'à max. 10 jours, des prestations supplémentaires telles qu'un fonds de pension indépendant financé par excellence et des rabais sur notre gamme complète de produits ainsi que des primes externes
Nous attendons avec intérêt vos documents de demande complets sous forme électronique.
Vous voulez en savoir plus sur nous ? Maintenant visitez notre page de carrière à jobs.bmsuisse.ch.
Nous sommes heureux de répondre à vos questions à jobs@bmsuisse.ch.

BMS Building Materials Suisse is a wholesaler of building materials for shell construction and interior construction. To our group of companies
Included are the renowned specialists Construction Needs, Richner, Gétaz Miauton and RegusciReco.
Our experienced experts advise, support and inspire customers from the construction industry with great commitment as well as
Private customers at 110 locations throughout Switzerland. Close to everyday construction, we are the local and reliable partner for
any building project. Quick, easy and competent.

You recognize optimization potential, think in a networked way and successfully implement ideas? Do you want to use innovative solutions to advance digitalization and strengthen cooperation between people, processes and technologies? Then you are exactly right with us.
In order to strengthen our team, we are looking for a committed personality as Project Manager Digitalisation by 1 September or by agreement.
In this versatile function, you strengthen our organization by developing, implementing and optimizing technical and process solutions. You actively contribute to achieving efficiency gains, implementing sustainable improvements and supporting further business growth.
You analyze the requirements from the business, structure and prioritize them and make sure they fit the company strategy.
Together with our specialist areas and external partners, you will develop practical solutions that create real added value.
You lead projects and sub-projects for the further development and digitalization of our business processes – from the idea to the successful implementation.
You recognize potential for optimization, initiate improvements and actively accompany changes.
You build up a network with industry experts and maintain it so that you can identify trends and innovations at an early stage.
You plan and organize trainings for our employees, carry them out and continuously develop digital learning content and training materials.
You define relevant KPIs, keep an eye on their development and derive insights from them for measuring the success of projects and innovations.
You provide regular reporting for transparency about use, costs, investments and the added value achieved.
If your heart beats faster in the task area described above and you bring the following skills, you are our desired candidate in:
You bring several years of experience in project work, project management or innovation management.
You have further education or higher vocational training in project management or in a comparable field of study.
You have in-depth IT knowledge that goes beyond common office applications.
You think analytically, tackle challenges in a solution-oriented manner and keep track of complex issues.
You work structured, independent and goal-oriented.
You communicate clearly and convincingly and manage to take different stakeholders and inspire new ideas.
Teamwork makes you happy and you like to work together with different people across different areas.
Even in challenging situations, you act constructively, solution-oriented and approach conflicts professionally.
You have very good knowledge of German and French. English skills are a plus.
You work agile and on your own responsibility and bring the willingness to travel within Switzerland.
a business car that can also be used in a private setting

the opportunity to live out your own creativity in a small team
a challenging, versatile and interesting job in a good working environment in which active cooperation and self-employment are emphasised
Intensive training is a program, whereby our new colleagues can benefit from product and system training within the company
Support our employees in their professional and personal development
5 weeks holiday (6 weeks from 50 years of age) and holiday shopping up to max. 10 days, additional benefits such as an excellently financed independent pension fund and discounts on our complete product range as well as external premium benefits

BMS Building Materials Suisse est un grossiste de matériaux de construction pour la construction en coque et la construction intérieure. À notre groupe d'entreprises
Sont inclus les spécialistes renommés Construction Needs, Richner, Gétaz Miauton et RegusciReco.
Nos experts expérimentés conseillent, soutiennent et inspirent les clients de l'industrie de la construction avec un grand engagement ainsi que
Clients privés à 110 endroits en Suisse. Proche de la construction quotidienne, nous sommes le partenaire local et fiable pour
tout projet de construction. Rapide, facile et compétent.

Vous reconnaissez le potentiel d'optimisation, pensez en réseau et appliquez avec succès des idées ? Voulez-vous utiliser des solutions innovantes pour promouvoir la numérisation et renforcer la coopération entre les personnes, les processus et les technologies? Alors vous avez raison avec nous.
Afin de renforcer notre équipe, nous recherchons une personnalité engagée en tant que Project Manager Digitalisation avant le 1er septembre ou par accord.
Dans cette fonction polyvalente, vous renforcez notre organisation en développant, implémentant et optimisant des solutions techniques et process. Vous contribuez activement à réaliser des gains d'efficacité, à mettre en œuvre des améliorations durables et à soutenir la croissance des entreprises.
Vous analysez les exigences de l'entreprise, structurez et priorisez-les et assurez-vous qu'elles correspondent à la stratégie de l'entreprise.
Avec nos domaines spécialisés et nos partenaires extérieurs, vous développerez des solutions pratiques qui créent une réelle valeur ajoutée.
Vous dirigez des projets et des sous-projets pour le développement et la numérisation de nos processus d'affaires – de l'idée à la mise en œuvre réussie.
Vous reconnaissez le potentiel d'optimisation, lancez des améliorations et accompagnez activement les changements.
Vous créez un réseau avec des experts de l'industrie et le maintenez pour pouvoir identifier les tendances et les innovations à un stade précoce.
Vous planifiez et organisez des formations pour nos employés, les exécutez et développez continuellement du contenu d'apprentissage numérique et du matériel de formation.
Vous définissez des ICR pertinents, gardez un œil sur leur développement et en tirez des idées pour mesurer le succès des projets et des innovations.
Vous fournissez régulièrement des rapports sur la transparence de l'utilisation, les coûts, les investissements et la valeur ajoutée obtenue.
Si votre cœur bat plus vite dans la zone de travail décrite ci-dessus et que vous apportez les compétences suivantes, vous êtes notre candidat désiré dans:
Vous apportez plusieurs années d'expérience dans le travail de projet, la gestion de projet ou la gestion de l'innovation.

BMS Building Materials Suisse is a wholesaler of structural and interior construction materials. Our group of companies includes the renowned specialists Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton and RegusciReco. Our experienced experts advise, support and inspire customers from the construction industry as well as private customers at around 110 locations throughout Switzerland. Close to everyday construction, we are the local and reliable partner for every construction project. Quick, easy and competent.
Do you love variety, are flexible and like to take action? Then we offer you an exciting challenge as a logistics jumper for our locations in Central Switzerland – immediately or by agreement.
Look forward to a versatile working day in which you actively control the flow of goods and optimize processes. As an organizational talent, you alternately support the locations of Cham and Hägendorf and ensure smooth processes.
Your main task includes handling goods incoming and outgoings as well as checking delivery notes
Other tasks include picking, packaging and provision of our products (building materials and tools).
In addition, you help with loading and unloading the trucks and customer vehicles
You are responsible for inventory work at the Cham and Hägendorf locations
Occasionally you also support in our shops and keep the overview there too
If your heart beats faster in the task area described above and you bring the following skills, you are our desired candidate in:
Training as a logistician EFZ, logistics assistant EBA or craftsman with professional experience in logistics > Forklift certificate mandatory!
Experience in the construction materials trade is advantageous
Independent and thinking working methods as well as a high commitment
Flexible, resilient and physically fit personality that can deal with weather-related circumstances
Awareness of occupational safety and a high sense of responsibility

BMS Building Materials Suisse is a wholesaler of structural and interior construction materials. Our group of companies includes the renowned specialists Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton and RegusciReco. Our experienced experts advise, support and inspire customers from the construction industry as well as private customers at around 110 locations throughout Switzerland. Close to everyday construction, we are the local and reliable partner for every construction project. Quick, easy and competent.
We are looking for an experienced and committed person in logistics for our location in Sevelen, who will support our team at 1. November or by agreement and contributes to the optimization of our logistical processes.
If you have a passion for efficient processes and enjoy working in a dynamic environment, then you are at the right place with us!
Apply now and become part of our successful logistics team.
Your main task includes handling goods incoming and outgoings as well as checking delivery notes
Other tasks include picking, packaging and provision of our products (building materials and tools).
In addition, you help with loading and unloading the trucks and customer vehicles
If your heart beats faster in the task area described above and you bring the following skills, you are our desired candidate in:
Training as a logistician EFZ, logistics assistant EBA or craftsman with professional experience in logistics > Forklift certificate mandatory!
Independent and thinking working methods as well as a high commitment
Flexible, resilient and physically fit personality that can deal with weather-related circumstances
Awareness of occupational safety and a high sense of responsibility
Good repute
Good knowledge of German in words and writing
a challenging, versatile and interesting job in a good working environment in which active cooperation and self-employment are emphasised
intensive training is a program, whereby our new colleagues can benefit from product and system training within the company
Support of our employees in their professional and personal development
No shift and weekend use

BMS Building Materials Suisse is a wholesaler of building materials for shell construction and interior construction. Our group of companies includes the renowned specialists Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton and RegusciReco. Our experienced experts advise, support and inspire customers from the construction industry as well as private customers at around 110 locations throughout Switzerland. Close to everyday construction, we are the local and reliable partner for every construction project. Quick, easy and competent.
Do you not only want to support existing systems, but also further develop our core applications with the possibilities of artificial intelligence? Then apply to us now and shape the future!
For our team at the Buchs (AG) or St. Légier (VD) location, search by 1. September 2026 or by appointment a creative and ambitious AI Application Manager who takes our digital processes to the next level.
Task area
You ensure the smooth operation of our core applications, coordinate updates and continuously develop them through the targeted use of AI solutions.
You lead and coordinate projects to integrate AI agents into existing business processes and drive intelligent automation of processes.
You manage and implement solutions in the area of Microsoft SharePoint and Power Automate.
You are the interface between departments and technical partners, translate requirements into technical specifications and jointly develop practical solutions.
You ensure compliance with data protection, security and compliance requirements – especially in connection with the use of AI services and LLM APIs.
If your heart beats faster in the task area described above and you bring the following competencies, you are our desired candidate:
You have several years of professional experience in application management, technical product management or in a comparable function and have successfully led or accompanied IT implementation projects.
You have already gained practical experience with generative AI technologies and are familiar with current developments around LLMs and AI Agents. Experience with tools and frameworks such as Claude, MCP servers or comparable technologies is an advantage.
You don’t have to be a senior developer, but you use modern AI development tools like Cursor or GitHub Copilot to quickly validate ideas and implement initial prototypes.
You bring experience with SharePoint and know its configuration and management. Knowledge of Dynamics 365, especially Business Central, is an advantage.
You have very good knowledge of German. Further language skills in English, French or Italian are beneficial.
You will analyze complex processes, identify potential for optimization and identify applications where AI can create real added value.
You communicate technical topics in an understandable way, work closely with different stakeholders and inspire users for new technologies.
a challenging, versatile and interesting job in a good working environment in which active cooperation and self-employment are emphasised

Support our employees in their professional and personal development

BMS Building Materials Suisse is a wholesaler of structural and interior construction materials. Our group of companies includes the renowned specialists Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton and RegusciReco. Our experienced experts advise, support and inspire customers from the construction industry as well as private customers at around 110 locations throughout Switzerland. Close to everyday construction, we are the local and reliable partner for every construction project. Quick, easy and competent.
We are looking for an experienced and committed person in logistics for our location in Grenchen, who will strengthen our team as of 1 July or by agreement and contribute to the optimization of our logistics processes.
If you have a passion for efficient processes and enjoy working in a dynamic environment, then you are at the right place with us!
Apply now and become part of our successful logistics team.
Your main task includes handling goods incoming and outgoings as well as checking delivery notes
Other tasks include picking, packaging and provision of our products (building materials and tools).
In addition, you help with loading and unloading the trucks and customer vehicles
If your heart beats faster in the task area described above and you bring the following skills, you are our desired candidate in:
Training as a logistician EFZ, logistics assistant EBA or craftsman with professional experience in logistics > Forklift certificate mandatory!
Independent and thinking working methods as well as a high commitment
Flexible, resilient and physically fit personality that can deal with weather-related circumstances
Awareness of occupational safety and a high sense of responsibility
Good repute

a challenging, versatile and interesting job in a good working environment in which active cooperation and self-employment are emphasised
intensive training is a program, whereby our new colleagues can benefit from product and system training within the company

Close to everyday construction, we are the local and reliable partner for every construction project. Quick, easy and competent.
Build the future with us!
You have a knack for precise organization, a feel for construction projects and are very familiar with submissions?
Then you are exactly right with us! We are looking for a motivated personality for our office in the field of shell construction, who will lead our projects to success with expertise and passion.
If you love co-creating projects from the foundation stone to the finished building while keeping track, we look forward to meeting you. Become part of our team in Wil SG and build a successful future together with us!

Technical clarifications with calculators and suppliers are also part of the daily work
The receipt and processing of supplier offers round off the field of activity

You enjoy dealing with people and are motivated to provide the best possible service for our customers
You have a completed apprenticeship in construction (adjacent) trade (preferably building / deep construction, plaster) or a commercial apprenticeship preferably with building materials knowledge
You are used to using a computer and are familiar with the common MS-Office programs, experience with ERP systems is an advantage
You bring a high sense of responsibility and negotiating skills
Resilience and flexibility are among your strengths
Style-confident knowledge of German in word and writing round off your profile
a challenging, versatile and interesting job in a good working environment in which active cooperation and self-employment are emphasised

Home office possible according to regulations

Become part of our team in Hunzenschwil and build a successful future together with us!

Technical clarifications with calculations and suppliers are also part of the daily work
The receipt and processing of supplier offers round off the field of activity

You enjoy dealing with people and are motivated to provide the best possible service for our customers

You have already gained leadership experience and are an implementation-strong person with a sales flair
Experience in creating and calculating submissions

BMS Building Materials Suisse is a wholesaler of building materials for shell construction and interior construction. Our group of companies includes the renowned specialists Baubedarf, Richner, Gétaz Miauton and RegusciReco. Our experienced experts advise, support and inspire customers from the construction industry as well as private customers at around 110 locations throughout Switzerland. Close to everyday construction, we are the local and reliable partner for every construction project. Quick, easy and competent.
Build the future with us!
You have a knack for precise organization, a feel for construction projects and are very familiar with submissions?
Then you are exactly right with us! We are looking for 1. March 2026 or by appointment a motivated personality for our office in the field of shell construction, who leads our projects to success with expertise and passion.
If you love co-creating projects from the foundation stone to the finished building while keeping track, we look forward to meeting you. Become part of our team in Schmerikon (SG) and build a successful future together with us!
Your main tasks in our customer care team include the reception, creation / processing of offers and submissions in the central office for the entire German-speaking Switzerland based in Schmerikon (SG) in close cooperation with the field service
You are also responsible for recording orders and complaint management
Should questions arise about our services or products, you provide competent telephone advice from our customers (mainly commercial customers)
Technical clarifications with calculators and suppliers are also part of the daily work
The receipt and processing of supplier offers round off the field of activity
If your heart beats faster in the task area described above and you bring the following competencies, you are our desired candidate:
You enjoy dealing with people and are motivated to provide the best possible service for our customers
You have a completed apprenticeship in construction (adjacent) trade (preferably building / deep construction, plaster) or a commercial apprenticeship preferably with building materials knowledge
You are used to using a computer and are familiar with the common MS-Office programs, experience in ERP and Sorba are an advantage
You bring a high sense of responsibility and negotiating skills
Resilience and flexibility are among your strengths
Style-confident knowledge of German in word and writing round off your profile
a challenging, versatile and interesting job in a good working environment in which active cooperation and self-employment are emphasised
Intensive training is a program, whereby our new colleagues can benefit from product and system training within the company
Support our employees in their professional and personal development
Home office possible according to regulations
Basic wage gross x 13 plus variable wage share
5 weeks holiday (6 weeks from 50 years of age) and holiday shopping up to max. 10 days, additional benefits such as an excellently financed independent pension fund and discounts on our complete product range as well as external premium benefits
